sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates via Frankfurter (annual average of daily rates, LCU per USD)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Cyclone Larry devastates far north Queensland
geopolitical_news.summary: Category 4 Cyclone Larry struck near Innisfail in March, destroying crops and homes across the region.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cole inquiry finds AWB paid kickbacks to Saddam regime
geopolitical_news.summary: The oil-for-food inquiry reported the wheat exporter paid bribes to Iraq, embarrassing the Howard government.

sport.headline: Melbourne hosts the Commonwealth Games
sport.summary: Australia topped the medal table at the Melbourne 2006 Games in front of home crowds.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kevin Rudd sweeps Labor to power
geopolitical_news.summary: Labor defeated John Howard's Coalition in November, ending eleven years of conservative government.

geopolitical_news.headline: Australia ratifies the Kyoto Protocol
geopolitical_news.summary: Rudd signed ratification in December, reversing Australia's long refusal to join the climate treaty.

sport.headline: Australia wins third straight Cricket World Cup
sport.summary: Ricky Ponting's side went unbeaten through the Caribbean tournament, beating Sri Lanka in the final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rudd delivers national apology to Stolen Generations
geopolitical_news.summary: The February apology in parliament acknowledged past policies removing Indigenous children from families.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government unveils stimulus as global crisis hits
geopolitical_news.summary: Bank deposit guarantees and cash payments were announced as the financial crisis reached Australia.

sport.headline: Australia finishes sixth at Beijing Olympics
sport.summary: Swimmers led a 46-medal haul, with Stephanie Rice winning three golds in the pool.

geopolitical_news.headline: Black Saturday bushfires kill 173 in Victoria
geopolitical_news.summary: The February fires became Australia's deadliest bushfire disaster, destroying whole towns including Marysville.

geopolitical_news.headline: Senate rejects Rudd's carbon pollution scheme
geopolitical_news.summary: The emissions trading legislation was voted down twice, stalling Labor's climate agenda.

sport.headline: Nadal outlasts Federer in epic Australian Open final
sport.summary: Rafael Nadal won a five-set classic in Melbourne, his first hard-court major title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Gillard ousts Rudd to become first female PM
geopolitical_news.summary: Labor dumped Kevin Rudd in a June leadership spill, installing deputy Julia Gillard unopposed.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hung parliament forces Labor-Green deal
geopolitical_news.summary: The August election delivered no majority; Gillard formed a minority government with Greens and independents.

sport.headline: Melbourne Storm stripped of titles in salary-cap scandal
sport.summary: The NRL found systematic cap breaches and stripped two premierships, fining the club heavily.

geopolitical_news.headline: Queensland floods and Cyclone Yasi batter the state
geopolitical_news.summary: Summer floods inundated Brisbane before Yasi, a huge cyclone, struck the north Queensland coast.

geopolitical_news.headline: Carbon tax legislation passes parliament
geopolitical_news.summary: Gillard's minority government secured the Clean Energy Act after a bruising political fight.

sport.headline: Socceroos lose Asian Cup final to Japan
sport.summary: Australia fell in extra time in Doha, missing a first continental title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Gillard's misogyny speech goes global
geopolitical_news.summary: The prime minister's October attack on Tony Abbott's sexism became an internationally watched moment.

geopolitical_news.headline: Asylum policy: offshore processing reopens
geopolitical_news.summary: After the Malaysia Solution was struck down, parliament restored processing on Nauru and Manus.

sport.headline: London Olympics brings leanest haul in decades
sport.summary: Australia won 35 medals and finished tenth, prompting a review of elite sport funding.

geopolitical_news.headline: Abbott ends six years of Labor government
geopolitical_news.summary: The Coalition won the September election decisively after Rudd's brief return as prime minister.

geopolitical_news.headline: Operation Sovereign Borders launched
geopolitical_news.summary: The new government began turning back asylum boats under a military-led border policy.

sport.headline: Australia reclaims the Ashes in 5-0 whitewash
sport.summary: Mitchell Johnson terrorised England as Australia swept the home series across the summer.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lindt Cafe siege ends in tragedy in Sydney
geopolitical_news.summary: A gunman held hostages for 16 hours in December; two hostages and the gunman died.

geopolitical_news.headline: Brisbane hosts G20 leaders' summit
geopolitical_news.summary: World leaders met in November amid tensions over Russia and climate inaction.

sport.headline: Phillip Hughes dies after on-field injury
sport.summary: The Test batsman's death from a bouncer strike shocked world cricket and prompted safety reviews.

geopolitical_news.headline: Turnbull ousts Abbott as prime minister
geopolitical_news.summary: Malcolm Turnbull won a September leadership spill, promising a new style of economic leadership.

geopolitical_news.headline: China-Australia free trade deal enters into force
geopolitical_news.summary: The long-negotiated ChAFTA took effect in December, cutting tariffs on farm goods and resources.

sport.headline: Australia wins fifth Cricket World Cup at home
sport.summary: Michael Clarke's team beat New Zealand in the Melbourne final before a record crowd.

geopolitical_news.headline: Turnbull returned with razor-thin majority
geopolitical_news.summary: The July double-dissolution election left the Coalition clinging to a one-seat lower house majority.

geopolitical_news.headline: Census website crashes on launch night
geopolitical_news.summary: The online census collapsed under load in August, drawing ridicule and an official inquiry.

sport.headline: Women's sevens team wins Olympic gold
sport.summary: Australia's women claimed rugby sevens gold on the sport's Olympic debut in Rio.

geopolitical_news.headline: Postal survey backs same-sex marriage
geopolitical_news.summary: Australians voted yes in the voluntary survey, and parliament legalised marriage equality in December.

geopolitical_news.headline: Manus Island detention centre closes
geopolitical_news.summary: The PNG centre shut in October, leaving a tense standoff between detainees and authorities.

sport.headline: Socceroos qualify for fourth straight World Cup
sport.summary: Australia beat Honduras in a playoff to book a place at Russia 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morrison becomes PM after Turnbull dumped
geopolitical_news.summary: Scott Morrison won an August leadership ballot after conservatives torpedoed Malcolm Turnbull.

geopolitical_news.headline: Banking royal commission exposes misconduct
geopolitical_news.summary: The Hayne inquiry's interim report detailed fee-gouging and misconduct across the big banks.

sport.headline: Ball-tampering scandal rocks Australian cricket
sport.summary: Smith, Warner and Bancroft were banned after the Cape Town sandpaper affair stunned the sport.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morrison wins surprise 'miracle' election
geopolitical_news.summary: The Coalition was re-elected in May against polling expectations, confounding Labor.

geopolitical_news.headline: Black Summer bushfires begin
geopolitical_news.summary: Catastrophic fires ignited across the east coast late in the year, foreshadowing a horror summer.

sport.headline: Australia retains the Ashes in England
sport.summary: A drawn series kept the urn in Australian hands for the first time in England since 2001.

geopolitical_news.headline: Borders shut as COVID-19 pandemic hits
geopolitical_news.summary: International borders closed in March and states locked down to suppress the virus.

geopolitical_news.headline: China imposes tariffs amid diplomatic freeze
geopolitical_news.summary: Beijing hit barley, wine and coal with trade measures as relations sank to historic lows.

sport.headline: AFL Grand Final played outside Victoria
sport.summary: Richmond beat Geelong in Brisbane in the first grand final held outside Melbourne.

geopolitical_news.headline: AUKUS pact announced with US and UK
geopolitical_news.summary: The September security deal promised nuclear-powered submarines and angered France and China.

geopolitical_news.headline: Australia commits to net zero by 2050
geopolitical_news.summary: Morrison announced the target before COP26 after long resistance from the Coalition.

sport.headline: Tokyo Olympics delivers record-equalling haul
sport.summary: Australia won 46 medals including 17 gold, matching its best gold tally from Athens 2004.

geopolitical_news.headline: Albanese ends nine years of Coalition rule
geopolitical_news.summary: Labor won the May election as Anthony Albanese became prime minister.

geopolitical_news.headline: Floods devastate eastern Australia
geopolitical_news.summary: Record floods inundated Lismore and parts of Sydney in a repeated La Nina disaster.

sport.headline: Australia tops Birmingham Commonwealth Games table
sport.summary: The team dominated the medal count in Birmingham ahead of the home 2026 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Indigenous Voice referendum defeated
geopolitical_news.summary: The October referendum to enshrine an Indigenous advisory body failed in every state.

geopolitical_news.headline: AUKUS submarine plan detailed
geopolitical_news.summary: Canberra unveiled the pathway to nuclear-powered submarines with Washington and London.

sport.headline: Matildas' World Cup run captivates the nation
sport.summary: Australia finished fourth at the home Women's World Cup, smashing television ratings records.

geopolitical_news.headline: Under-16 social media ban legislated
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament passed world-first age restrictions for social media platforms in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: King Charles visits Australia
geopolitical_news.summary: The monarch's October tour was his first to Australia as king.

sport.headline: Paris Olympics brings record 53 medals
sport.summary: Australia finished fourth on the table with 18 golds, its biggest Olympic haul ever.

geopolitical_news.headline: Labor wins second term in landslide
geopolitical_news.summary: Anthony Albanese secured a thumping May re-election victory over the Coalition.

geopolitical_news.headline: Erin Patterson convicted of mushroom murders
geopolitical_news.summary: The Victorian woman was found guilty of murdering three relatives with a poisoned beef Wellington.

sport.headline: Lions defeat Wallabies 2-1 in series
sport.summary: The British and Irish Lions won the Test series in Australia despite a Wallabies fightback.
